description: Lab tests dated on 1985-04-22 or on 1994-03-14 are included in the range, along with every test between them.

d.request: For laboratory tests with `Date` text from '1985-04-22' through '1994-03-14' inclusive, group by `CENTROMEA` (NULL as its own group), and return each group's average `HGB`, its average per-test `T-BIL`/`CRE` ratio (nulls ignored), and that average ratio divided by the unweighted mean of all groups' average ratios, unrounded, with no output if that mean is null.
d.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, `T-BIL` * 1.0 / CRE AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14'), grp AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM filtered GROUP BY CENTROMEA), mean_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg_ratio FROM grp) SELECT grp.CENTROMEA, grp.avg_hgb, grp.avg_ratio, grp.avg_ratio / mean_ratio.mean_avg_ratio AS ratio_to_mean_of_groups FROM grp CROSS JOIN mean_ratio WHERE mean_ratio.mean_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL;

b.request: For Laboratory rows whose stored Date text satisfies '1985-04-22' <= Date <= '1994-03-14' (inclusive), group by CENTROMEA with NULL as its own group, and return per group AVG(HGB), AVG of per-test T-BIL/CRE with NULLs ignored, and that group's average ratio divided by the unweighted mean of all groups' average ratios, returning no ratio-based value when that overall mean is NULL, unrounded.
b.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL`) AS avg_tbil, AVG(CRE) AS avg_cre, AVG(`T-BIL` / CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM g) SELECT g.CENTROMEA, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_tbil, g.avg_cre, g.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN m.overall_mean IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE g.avg_ratio / m.overall_mean END AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m;
b.raw: For Laboratory rows whose stored Date text satisfies '1985-04-22' <= Date <= '1994-03-14' (inclusive), group by CENTROMEA with NULL as its own group, and return per group AVG(HGB), AVG of per-test T-BIL/CRE with NULLs ignored, and that group's average ratio divided by the unweighted mean of all groups' average ratios, returning no ratio-based value when that overall mean is NULL, unrounded.

a.request: Using laboratory tests dated from 1985-04-22 through 1994-03-14 inclusive (comparing the `Date` text as stored), for each anti-centromere status (`CENTROMEA`, with a missing status as its own group), give the status, the average hemoglobin (`HGB`), the average of each test's total bilirubin-to-creatinine ratio (`T-BIL` ÷ `CRE`), and that average ratio divided by the plain mean of all the statuses' average ratios. Ignore missing values in every average, return nothing if that overall mean is missing, and don't round.
a.sql: WITH per_group AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_group) SELECT p.status, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio / o.overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM per_group p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL;

c.request: For laboratory tests between 1985-04-22 and 1994-03-14 (comparing the `Date` text as stored), what is the average hemoglobin (`HGB`) and the average total bilirubin-to-creatinine ratio (`T-BIL` ÷ `CRE`, per test) for each anti-centromere status (`CENTROMEA`, with a missing status as its own group)? Also give each status's average ratio divided by the plain mean of all the statuses' average ratios. Ignore missing values in the averages, return nothing if that overall mean is missing, and don't round. Lab tests dated on 1985-04-22 or on 1994-03-14 are included in the range, along with every test between them.
c.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, `T-BIL` * 1.0 / NULLIF(CRE, 0) AS r FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), g AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(r) AS avg_ratio FROM t GROUP BY CENTROMEA), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.CENTROMEA, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / m.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM g, m WHERE m.overall IS NOT NULL;
